name: Nibby
description: Nibby's presence schedule - training, hanging out, and occasionally disappearing

default.return_message: *wanders back into camp, looking like he's been up to something*

default_return_message: *returns, trying to look casual* ...What? I wasn't gone that long.
manual_away_message: *glances around* I've got something I need to take care of. Be back later. *slips away*

entries.away_message: *grabs his bow and pack* Tyren wants me for training this weekend. Try not to have too much fun without me. *rolls eyes but looks a little excited*
*yawns and stretches* Alright, I'm gonna crash. Don't do anything interesting without me. *heads to his tent*
*grabs his bow* Off to the range. Gotta keep these skills sharp. *jogs off toward the practice field*
